Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: Incorrect Identification of the Film Star and Character Mapping. The Planner incorrectly assumed that the star of the film "Hero and the Terror" is Chuck Norris. In reality, the film "Hero and the Terror" (1992) stars Jean-Claude Van Damme as the character "Hero" (and the villain "Terror"). The Planner then erroneously mapped this actor to the role of "J.J. McQuade" in *Walker, Texas Ranger*, which was actually played by Chuck Norris. This fundamental factual error regarding the cast of the source film led to the wrong final answer.
